title: [Nexus] Forest Fight v1.0

replies.author: Matic0B
replies.body:
Its very flat. You should terraform it a little bit even if its for Nexus. Even one or two block differences in height can make a huge improvement over none.

You should also add some buildings like houses or just some stone buildings (maybe a little destroyes) or something like towers in the sides so its not only the forest. Its a little bit boring if you just go through trees and fight on the flatland next to the middle.

You should also add lilypads in the ponds. Not too much, just one here and there to spice it up a little bit.

Other than that, great job!
